title: Proper and open comparison on bounded origins
statement: Let O be a commutative ring and ell in O with all O/(ell^(n+1)) finite. Fix a compactification X --j--> Z --p--> Y of a morphism f, a strict etale compact-support package S, and its exceptional right adjunction G [def-sf-strict-etale-exceptional-adjoint-interfaces]. Fix actual site comparison packages CX,CY,CZ at S.PX,S.PY,S.PZ satisfying the bounded-origin equivalence clauses [def-pur-exceptional-system-transport-interfaces]. There exist an actual strict pro-etale compact-support package P and its proper/open comparison R [def-coef-system-site-transport-interfaces]. The comparison C_Y S -> P C_X is invertible on bounded-below etale systems. P preserves system origin and its finite operation preserves finite origin. The finite source-counit version of R is invertible on finite origin. For every n and finite origin N at Y, G_n(V_Y,n N) is bounded below. Evaluation of R followed by P's evaluation comparison and the image of CX's inverse-evaluation comparison equals CY's inverse-evaluation comparison followed by CY,n of S's evaluation comparison and then the finite R. This is an equality of actual derived morphisms, for every n and input, not merely equality on cohomology.

source.place: Zheng Construction 5.15 and Lemmas 4.10, 5.16 and 5.22; Stacks 0B65.

proof.text: Apply the construction theorem to obtain P and R, then apply the bounded-origin properties theorem to the same data and package the resulting conjunction.

proof_origin.place: Construction 5.15 and Lemmas 4.10, 5.16 and 5.22; existence and bounded-origin properties split into two strictly simpler statements.
